svg.title: All-terrain mobile crane — Færanlegur fjölöxla krani
svg.desc: A multi-axle road carrier supports an extended telescopic crane boom and deployed short outriggers.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-all-terrain-mobile-crane","label_en":"All-terrain mobile crane","label_is":"Færanlegur fjölöxla krani","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["lifting","crane"],"description":"A multi-axle road carrier supports an extended telescopic crane boom and deployed short outriggers.","design_note":"Three road axles, a closed telescopic boom and outriggers distinguish this mobile crane from a crawler.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
